# Findings 2026-07-22

- Share dialog should be a popover
- AI onboarding is to visually overwhelming, change it from overlay to fill the sidebar (white bg), no card.
- "meet" should be either "start meeting" or it should create a new meeting without starting.
- Meetings always show 'leave' button even when it ended or when you already left.
- Kanban board can be rendered in a document but it's too tall.
- REGRESSION: Dropdowns can show two focus/hover states, one for mouse and one for keyboard. They should take over instead.
- Opening a new tab to a different drive should auto-switch to the drive.
- On Chrome, site instantly asks for loopback network permission.
- Signup flow with password manager is weird. It saves your recovery password as a normal password. You then have to save your secret manually.
- Sync page is confusing, 'Connect a device' button shown above 'Sync a device' section. Both do something different.
- User page: 'Open a drive by URL or DID' is ugly and feels out of place on the user page.
